figures.caption: Figure 3: Regime Transition Probability Matrix Π. Each cell Πs,s′ encodes the learned probability of transitioning from regime st−1 (row) to regime st (column). High diagonal values confirm that regimes are persistent, while off-diagonal kill-chain transitions (0→ 1→ 2→ 3) enable predictive alerting.
Table 3: Learned Regime Transition Probability Matrix Π̂ (CICIDS2017). Rows denote the current regime st−1; columns denote the next regime st.

Figure 2: Regime Posterior Probabilities vs. Time (CICIDS2017 scenario). The PARD-SSM system raises a Reconnaissance alert (t = 12 min) approximately 8 minutes before the ground-truth attack onset (t = 20 min), demonstrating predictive kill-chain detection capability. Posteriors sum to unity ( ∑3 s=0 γt(s) = 1) at each time-step.

The dashed feedback arrow denotes the online EM loop by which Module 5 (OEMPU) continuously updates regime-specific parameters in Module 3 (PRKFB).
